name: Sprite font
description: Displays some text on the screen using a sprite sheet.

conditions.description: Compare the text in this object.

text-to-compare.name: Text to compare
text-to-compare.desc: Enter the text to compare with the object's content.

case-sensitivity.name: Case sensitivity
case-sensitivity.desc: Choose whether capital letters count as different to lowercase.  If ignoring case, "ABC" matches "abc".

conditions.description: True if currently writing out typewriter text.
Triggered when typewriter text finishes writing out all the text.
Check if a BBcode tag style is set at a given position.

actions.description: Set the background blend mode for this object.

blend-mode.name: Blend mode
blend-mode.desc: Choose the new blend mode for this object.

actions.description: Set the scale of the spritefont image.

scale.name: Scale
scale.desc: Enter the scale of the spritefont image.

actions.description: Set the spacing between each character.

character-spacing.name: Character spacing
character-spacing.desc: Enter the number of pixels for the spacing between characters.

actions.description: Set the spacing between each line.

line-height.name: Line height
line-height.desc: Enter the number of pixels for the spacing between lines.

actions.description: Change the width of some characters.

character.name: Character
character.desc: Enter one or more characters to change the width for (e.g. "abcd").

width.name: Width
width.desc: Enter the number of pixels width you want the character(s) to occupy. This should be less than the cell width.

actions.description: Set the horizontal alignment of the text.

horizontal-alignment.name: Horizontal alignment
horizontal-alignment.desc: Choose the new horizontal alignment for the text.

actions.description: Set the vertical alignment of the text.

vertical-alignment.name: Vertical alignment
vertical-alignment.desc: Choose the new vertical alignment for the text.

actions.description: Set whether to wrap text by space-separated words or by character.

wrapping.name: Wrapping
wrapping.desc: Wrap text by space-separated words or by character.

actions.description: Set the text of this object.

text.name: Text
text.desc: Enter the text to set the object's content to.

actions.description: Add text to the end of the existing text.

text.name: Text
text.desc: Enter the text to append to the object's content.

actions.description: Set the text over time by starting with an empty string and gradually adding characters.

text.name: Text
text.desc: Enter the text to set the object's content to over time.

duration.name: Duration
duration.desc: The time in seconds to write out the text.

actions.description: Force a typewriter text effect to finish immediately.
Set whether the text is read aloud while using a screen reader.

expressions.description: Get the width of a character.

character.name: Character
character.desc: Character to get width for (empty for default)

expressions.description: Get the height of a character.
Get the scale of the characters.
Get the width extent of the text in the object in pixels.
Get the height extent of the text in the object in pixels.
Get the object's text with any BBcode tags stripped out.
Get the BBcode tag style at a given position, or an empty string if none.
Get the number of BBcode style tags for a specific tag.
Get X co-ordinate of a BBcode style tag.

index.name: Index
index.desc: The tag index, in case there are multiple.

expressions.description: Get Y co-ordinate of a BBcode style tag.

index.name: Index
index.desc: The tag index, in case there are multiple.

expressions.description: Get width of a BBcode style tag.

index.name: Index
index.desc: The tag index, in case there are multiple.

expressions.description: Get height of a BBcode style tag.

index.name: Index
index.desc: The tag index, in case there are multiple.

enable-bbcode.name: Enable BBCode
enable-bbcode.desc: Allow use of BBCode tags in the text, e.g. [scale=2]big text[/scale].

edit-image.name: Sprite font
edit-image.desc: Click to edit the object's spritefont.

character-width.name: Character width
character-width.desc: Width of each cell in the image.

character-height.name: Character height
character-height.desc: Height of each cell in the image.

character-set.name: Character set
character-set.desc: List of characters in the spritefont image, starting in the top-left.

spacing-data.name: Spacing data
spacing-data.desc: Data describing individual character widths in JSON format.

scale.name: Scale
scale.desc: Amount to scale the drawn text by.

character-spacing.name: Character spacing
character-spacing.desc: Extra pixel width to add between displayed characters.

line-height.name: Line height
line-height.desc: Offset to the default line height, in pixels. 0 is default line height.

horizontal-alignment.name: Horizontal alignment
horizontal-alignment.desc: Horizontal alignment of the text inside its bounding box.

vertical-alignment.name: Vertical alignment
vertical-alignment.desc: Vertical alignment of the text inside its bounding box.

wrapping.name: Wrapping
wrapping.desc: Wrap text by space-separated words or by character.

initially-visible.name: Initially visible
initially-visible.desc: Choose whether the object is visible when the layout starts.

origin.name: Origin
origin.desc: Choose the location of the origin in the object.

read-aloud.name: Read aloud
read-aloud.desc: Check for text to be read aloud when it appears or changes while using a screen reader.
